Name: Seasonal Retexture of Zinnia in Nyapu's style
Author: PureJJoy
Description:
I've been woking on this for a month now and I'm happy with the results ❤️ These are just PNGs so you need to replace the original portraits with these.
 

[b]Instructions[/b]
1. Unzip the file2. Copy the images in said file3. Go to "Mods\[CP] CakeyBunz Zinnia Retexture\assets\Portraits" and paste the images4. Press replace files and you're done!
That all, Enjoy!
